title: Workshop events "Let's talk Future of Cardano".

ms.promise:
We need to research the history and current state of Cardano and prepare the necessary materials for the workshop. We have gathered about 10 core members who agree with this proposal. We will have a pre-workshop with the core members on what kind of workshop materials should be developed. It will be held several times. First, we will assign roles for what each member will research and compile, and in the next workshop we will discuss the materials we have brought. In this way, the format and materials for the actual workshop will be developed.
Ultimately, the workshop materials will be produced and that will be the output.
At the same time, the core members involved in this work can become workshop facilitators.
ms.criteria: We complete the final system documentation and workshop methodology through a series of surveys and meetings. Evidence is provided through meeting minutes, participant photos, and research materials.
ms.report:
We developed workshop materials and filmed a video demonstration.
With this video, we were ready to host workshops in various locations or online, with each member moderating.
We have added English subtitles as you recently pointed out. Please note that we are not native English speakers and are using AI, so some parts may not be accurate.
